title: Clean up hidden metadata files (._*)
summary: Remove or merge the hidden '._' files that macOS creates for file metadata. This is useful when copying files to non-Mac drives or sharing folders where these files appear as clutter.

steps.explain: Merge the metadata from ._ files into the main files and delete the ._ files. This is the standard cleanup.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the folder containing the files to clean
